Recompute FNR within each seed from 2-2*BA-FPR; compare seed values, mean, sample SD

protocol_identity_checks: Checkpoint replay .624503 is distinct from multigen same-protocol source-only rerun .624399.
Relative-BCE reliability AUROC is separated from fake/real detection AUROC.
Paired-half uses matched global as primary reference, with all four planned summary scopes retained.
Final main_macro includes exactly GLIDE, Midjourney, VQDM, Wukong; ADM/BigGAN final results are separate.
FNR seed SD is derived from paired seed values, not inferred from marginal BA/FPR SDs.
evidence_sufficiency: Existing evidence supports the report narrative of weak performance, targeted repairs, partial recovery and remaining limitations. New training is not required for that bounded claim.
useful_no_training_additions: The completed threshold FNR/FPR decomposition makes practical tradeoffs explicit.
The completed all-condition paired decomposition retains counterexamples and quantifies uncertainty conditional on frozen models.
Retain a provenance/protocol registry and portable source snapshots; do not merge distinct protocols into a leaderboard.
new_training_only_if_stronger_mechanisti: Controlled fixed-scaler versus refit-scaler arms to isolate scaling effects in mixture training.
Raw-logit versus probability gate-input ablation with other factors fixed.
Feature removal followed by retraining, distinct from frozen-network input replacement.
Fixed-budget expert-level multi-generator training, distinct from the completed gate-only study.
limits: Arithmetic review does not repeat training or independently replay all historical bootstrap intervals.
Three seeds share pools; seed SD is not a population confidence interval.
The final threshold decomposition is descriptive, not an isolation of threshold versus calibration versus representation causes.
Checkpoint/routing repairs are post-final development studies without independent new final confirmation.
No claim is made that the selected comparison table contains every possible pairwise contrast; complete archived metric tables remain available.
